On May 29, 2026, the Financial Condition Report (the “FCR”) for International General Insurance Holdings Ltd. for the year ending December 31, 2025 was published on the Company’s website, www.iginsure.com, in the “Investors” section under “Financial Information,” “Statutory Financial Reporting and Financial Condition Reports.” The FCR has been filed with the Bermuda Monetary Authority and includes, among other things, details of the Company’s business and performance, governance, risk management framework, legal, regulatory and compliance structure, risk profile, solvency valuation and capital management.

 

The information included in this Form 6-K is being furnished and shall not be deemed “filed” for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the “Exchange Act”), or incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or the Exchange Act, except as shall be expressly set forth by specific reference in such filing.
